item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a cell, an electric fan, and a switch S. The switch is open, so its contacts do not touch.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: The circuit is OFF because the open switch breaks the path, so current cannot reach the fan.
options.B: The circuit is ON because the cell still pushes current across the open gap to the fan.
options.C: If Arjun closes switch S, the path is completed and the fan can run.
options.D: The open switch itself supplies current to the fan.
